source_instruction: i want silver and noise cancelling earbuds.
query: Ugh, I swear my cat knocked over my favorite potted succulent this morning and got soil all over the living room rug, I spent like 20 minutes scrubbing it out before I even thought about making coffee. Also I realized I forgot to pick up more cat litter on my last grocery run, so I have to swing by the pet store after this too, and I still haven’t figured out what to bring to my friend’s potluck this weekend, maybe those chocolate chip cookies I baked last time? Wait, anyway, I need noise cancelling headphones, white-silver would be nice.
